preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 15 narrates Saul's failure to execute the herem against Amalek and Samuel's rejection oracle ('to obey is better than sacrifice'). 4QSamᵃ preserves portions with some agreements with LXX in the rejection-oracle wording.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor variants. The famous declaration in v. 22 ('to obey is better than sacrifice') tracks MT in substance.

variant_notes: 'To obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams' tracks MT — one of the great prophetic-cult formulations, echoed at Hos 6:6, Mic 6:6–8, Mark 12:33.

'The Glory of Israel will not lie or repent, for he is not a man, that he should repent' tracks MT — striking statement of divine immutability in tension with v. 35 ('the LORD repented that he had made Saul king'). The DSS does not resolve the tension.
